correctness.rationale: Each internal vertex has degree two, so every simple cycle uses two entire arms and has vertex set {s,t}∪A_i∪A_j. These sets are incomparable because the arm blocks are disjoint and nonempty, hence are precisely the minimal nonfaces. Dual facets are their complements in the full N-element ground set (including the two ghost vertices of the dual). To remove a nonrepresentative vertex w in A_i from the dual, pair faces containing w but not its representative a_i with those obtained by adjoining a_i; deleting pairs in descending size gives elementary collapses. The surviving faces are the subsets of at most m−2 arm representatives. Their reduced integral homology is concentrated in degree m−3 with rank m−1: in the full simplex the boundaries of all (m−2)-simplices containing a fixed vertex form a basis for the cycles of the truncated chain complex; they have distinct faces omitting the fixed vertex, and the cone contraction supplies spanning. This gives rank two reduced H_0 for m=3 as well. The duality shift N−j−3 therefore gives d=N−m. The original complex includes the full 2-skeleton by triangle-freeness. With simple connectivity and no lower reduced homology, successive Hurewicz applications give spherical representatives in degree d≥2; the resulting homology equivalence from a wedge of d-spheres is a homotopy equivalence by Whitehead. A separate argument via one-point suspension (in the originality analysis) gives the same full result. The frozen mod-two checker and recorded finite output were inspected but not executed and are not the proof of the integral homotopy statement.
residual_risks: No assertion for direct pole edges, extra graph edges, finite-degree stages of the forest filtration or equivariant homotopy.
